# Jpeg: baseline JPEG images decoded to RGBA
# @weight 2

The images were written by libjpeg-turbo 3.2.1's cjpeg from one 17 x 11
picture (ImageMagick's `plasma:red-blue`, seed 7) and are carried here in
hex.  Each case's expected value is the CRC-32 of the RGB djpeg decodes the
file to by default, with alpha 255 after each pixel
(`djpeg -ppm F.jpg | magick ppm:- rgba:-`).  djpeg answers the same bytes
with its SIMD code turned off (JSIMD_FORCENONE=1), and ImageMagick the same
again.  17 x 11 leaves every sampling a partial MCU on the right and at the
bottom.

## images

### one 8 x 8 block of one colour: the RGBA itself

```x
(do (import x/codec/jpeg) (import x/codec/bytes)
  (def r (Bytes of-hex ""))
  (Bytes hex (list (List ref 2 (Jpeg decode (first r) 0 (List ref 2 r))) 0 8)))
```
---
    "3080bfff3080bfff"

### 4:2:0: chroma upsampled 2 x 2, the triangle filter on both axes

```x
(do (import x/codec/jpeg) (import x/codec/bytes) (import x/codec/crc32)
  (def r (Bytes of-hex ""))
  (def d (Jpeg decode (first r) 0 (List ref 2 r)))
  (list (first d) (List ref 1 d) (Crc32 of (List ref 2 d) 0 (* 4 (* (first d) (List ref 1 d))))))
```
---
    (17 11 3687050379)

## what is not decoded

### a progressive image raises

```x
(do (import x/codec/jpeg) (import x/codec/bytes)
  (def r (Bytes of-hex ""))
  (guard (e (e msg)) (Jpeg decode (first r) 0 (List ref 2 r))))
```
---
    "Jpeg: a progressive JPEG is not decoded yet"

### not a JPEG

```x
(do (import x/codec/jpeg) (import x/codec/bytes)
  (def r (Bytes of-hex "00d8ffe000104a46494600"))
  (guard (e (e msg)) (Jpeg decode (first r) 0 (List ref 2 r))))
```
---
    "Jpeg: not a JPEG: no SOI marker"
